answer: Fresh-task vine bond: each epoch a pulse draw hands every identity one fresh task from a public vine, velvet-sealed. Drawn after opening, no work can be bought ahead; the agent completes it and files proof. A copied receipt or work by another key burns the 60-credit bond. First task 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent does one fresh task, pays 40, and keeps its bond.
